regulation_name: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria

requirements.text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values
The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight
The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control
The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of risks
The entity identifies risks to achievement of objectives and analyzes risks as basis for risk management
The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to mitigation of risks
The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets
The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside boundaries
The entity restricts transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized personnel and processes
The entity monitors system components and operation for anomalies indicating security events
The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in failure of controls
The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing defined incident response program
The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet objectives
The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections to meet objectives

The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet objectives
